2608.07606.title: Enhanced Real-Time 6-DOF Extended Reality Catheter Tracking for Evaluating Potential Improvement in Efficiency, Precision, and Depth Perception for Cardiac Interventions
2608.07606.paper_summary: Despite advances in 3D ultrasound, most percutaneous cardiac interventions still rely on 2D visualization, limiting depth perception and spatial understanding. To address this challenge, we developed an Extended Reality (XR)-based platform that enables real-time six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) catheter tracking and visualization within a patient-specific 3D heart model. The system combines a custom machine-vision algorithm for 5-DOF catheter tracking with a 3D-printed electromechanical encoder that measures catheter roll, providing complete 6-DOF motion reconstruction. In a proof-of-concept study, 20 novice medical students navigated an intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) catheter to six anatomical targets using either immersive 3D visualization or a conventional 2D cathlab-style view. Participants in the 3D condition completed the task in 54.6 seconds and traveled 1,939 mm on average, compared with 267.5 seconds and 7,854 mm in the 2D condition. Therefore, the XR-based 3D system was more than 5x faster and required ~5x less catheter travel. The 3D mode also improved targeting precision and reduced performance variability. Participants consistently rated immersive visualization higher for accuracy, speed, usability, and clinical value. Kinematic analysis showed smoother depth-axis navigation in 3D, whereas 2D users relied on repeated corrective movements. These findings demonstrate that XR-based visualization can substantially improve procedural training efficiency, precision, and motor control.
2608.07606.paper_summary_zh: 儘管3D超聲波技術已有所進步，大多數經皮心臟介入手術仍依賴2D視覺，這限制了深度感知和空間理解。為了解決這一挑戰，我們開發了一個基於擴增實境（XR）的平臺，能夠在患者特定的3D心臟模型中實現實時六自由度（6-DOF）導管追蹤和可視化。該系統結合了一種自定義的機器視覺算法，用於5-DOF導管追蹤，以及一個3D打印的電子機械編碼器，該編碼器測量導管的滾轉，提供完整的6-DOF運動重建。在一項概念驗證研究中，20名初學醫學生使用沉浸式3D可視化或傳統的2D心導管室視圖，導航一根心內超聲（ICE）導管到六個解剖目標。3D條件下的參與者在54.6秒內完成任務，平均行駛1,939毫米，而在2D條件下則為267.5秒和7,854毫米。因此，基於XR的3D系統速度超過5倍，且所需的導管行駛距離約減少5倍。3D模式還提高了目標精度並減少了性能變異性。參與者一致認為沉浸式可視化在準確性、速度、可用性和臨床價值方面更高。運動學分析顯示3D中的深度軸導航更平滑，而2D用戶則依賴重複的修正動作。這些發現表明，基於XR的可視化可以顯著提高程序訓練的效率、精度和運動控制。
